title: Cargo
summary: Checks offline Cargo builds and registry isolation.

minimumGuestMemory.derivation: E25 ruling 156. The 512 MiB ARM free-frame floor is 88,532, and the K5 uses-std budget is 89,568. Add 24,800 frames for the pinned Mac Cargo twin's peak RSS during the offline workspace build (101,580,800 bytes from macOS time -l), 6,755 PT_LOAD frames for Cargo, 455 for the Cargo runner, 118 for its interpreter and 395 for libc PT_LOAD and extra DSO pages. The 122,091-frame total fits the projected 219,604 free frames at 1024 MiB with a 25% reserve.
